name: Listen Live Plugin for FPP
author: jessica12ryan
description: Listen to your show's live audio directly from within the FPP UI. Streams the FPP audio output to the browser via an HTML5 player with live status, volume control, and file-sync fallback. Works with PulseAudio, ALSA, or direct media file streaming.

privacy.summary: Streams your show's live audio to your browser on your home network so you can hear what the audience hears. Nothing is sent to the internet.
privacy.other: Settings stay in config/settings.json and the log stays at logs/plugin-fpp-ListenLive.log until you clear them. Your browser keeps its own volume choice in localStorage.
